milestone: Conservative fluid-only 2:1 D3Q27 remapping and acoustic level scaling
scope: Explicit pre-collision, unforced, low-Mach populations; regularized second-order non-equilibrium moments
Acoustic dx/dt scaling, shear and bulk relaxation scaled separately
Five-point conservative cell-average prediction in each spatial direction; eight-child volume restriction
Conserved-variable time interpolation for the fine half step

Solid walls, forces and checkpoints on multiple levels
SGS-dependent local relaxation, compressibility up to physical Mach 0.4
Production GUI switch or claims of validated airfoil coefficients
